sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: These two examples show the same idea in two different formats.

steps: Both are supplementary to the same angle.
Angles supplementary to the same angle are equal.
workedSolution.answer: both supplementary to a common angle

items.prompt: Parallel lines, transversal, one angle 70°. Alternate interior angle?

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: In a triangle, the two remote interior angles measure 52° and 65°. Find the exterior angle at the third vertex.
In a parallelogram, one angle measures 71°. Find the consecutive angle.
In a triangle, a segment joins the midpoints of two sides. The third side measures 48. Find the length of the midsegment and state its relationship to the third side.
choices: 24, and it is parallel to the third side
48, and it is parallel to the third side
96, and it is parallel to the third side
24, and it is perpendicular to the third side

items.prompt: A proof concludes that base angles of an isosceles triangle are congruent, after constructing the bisector of the apex angle. Which statement supplies the missing justification?
choices: The bisector is perpendicular to the base by definition.
The two smaller triangles are congruent by SAS, so their corresponding base angles are congruent.
The base angles look equal in the diagram.
All triangles have congruent base angles.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. One angle measures 62°. Find the measure of the corresponding angle.
In a triangle, the two remote interior angles measure 32° and 40°. Find the exterior angle at the third vertex.
In a parallelogram, one angle measures 33°. Find the opposite angle.
In a triangle, a segment joins the midpoints of two sides. The third side measures 96. Find the length of the midsegment and state its relationship to the third side.
choices: 96, and it is parallel to the third side
48, and it is perpendicular to the third side
192, and it is parallel to the third side
48, and it is parallel to the third side

items.prompt: A proof concludes that vertical angles are congruent. Which statement supplies the missing justification?
choices: The angles are congruent because they are opposite in position.
Vertical angles are congruent by definition.
Each vertical angle is supplementary to the same adjacent angle, so both have the same measure.
The two lines are parallel, forcing the angles to match.
